description:
SUBJECT: Freight Handling and Storage Services

SOLICITATION TYPE: Request for Quotation (RFQ) - Brand Name

This is a pre-solicitation notice for planning purposes only. U.S. Embassy Algiers intends to solicit quotations for Swissport Freight Handling and Storage Services. This procurement is being conducted as a vendor name acquisition based on a signed Justification for Other Than Full and Open Competition (JOFOC).

SERVICE REQUIRED:

Swissport Freight Handling and Storage Services, including but not limited to Handling the incoming pouch shipment deliveries both unclassified/classified for the Mission. Safe and secure storage of Diplomatic Pouch and Mail,

DELIVERY LOCATION: 05, Chemin Cheikh Bachir El Ibrahimi, El Biar, Algiers 16030, Algeria.

POINT OF CONTACT: Algiers_Procurement@state.gov

The formal solicitation will be posted on SAM.gov on or around April 08, 2026.

NOTE: This is not a request for quotations. Do not submit quotes in response to this notice.
